details: Both Sandra and Priya independently track issues — Sandra via the ERT parallel tracker and Priya via IssuesPortal. Their coverage overlaps for roughly 40% of active issues.
Both perform aspects of the LossDB triangulation process. Combined they spend 1.2 FTE on cross-system validation that proper integration would eliminate.
Marcus assembles the board risk report while Robert validates reporting hub data. Their processes overlap during monthly reporting cycles with duplicative data pulls.
Both maintain parallel tracking of audit findings — Liam via the audit committee prep spreadsheet and Jennifer via the follow-up tracker. Reconciliation between the two is informal.
Kevin manages change dual-entry while Sandra manages the GRC platform. Both touch Archer and the change management ecosystem, creating coordination overhead.
